step1_figure.circuit_type: Comparator pre-amplifier with positive feedback decision circuit
step1_figure.description: Figure 27.5 shows the schematic of the differential pre-amplification stage (M1, M2 with diode loads M31, M41 and tail current source Iss) driving current mirrors (M3, M4) that feed an active cross-coupled NMOS positive-feedback decision circuit (M5-M8).

switching_point_high.description: Upper switching point threshold voltage (VSPH = vp - vm) where the decision circuit flips states during an increasing input differential

equation.explanation: Calculates the positive switching threshold voltage required to steer enough differential current into the cross-coupled regenerative load M5-M8 to initiate state transition.
equation.assumptions: beta_B >= beta_A; differential pair operates in the active region; Iss splits between M1 and M2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With beta_B = beta_A (symmetric load M5=M6=M7=M8 as in design 1 of Ex. 27.1), (beta_B/beta_A - 1) = 0, giving VSPH = 0 V (no hysteresis). If sized with beta_B / beta_A = 1.2 (as in design 2), with Iss = 40 uA, gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (Iss/2)) = sqrt(2 * 270u * (10/1) * 20u) = 328.6 uA/V: VSPH = (40u / 328.6u) * (0.2 / 2.2) = 121.7 mV * 0.0909 = 11.1 mV. For nominal symmetric design, VSPH = 0 V (typically 0 to 25 mV if sizing imbalance is applied).
sky130_expected.reasoning: For equal transistor sizing (beta_A = beta_B), hysteresis is zero (VSPH = 0 V). With intentional ratio mismatch of ~1.2, VSPH is ~11 to 24 mV.

switching_point_low.description: Lower switching point threshold voltage (VSPL = vp - vm) when vp is decreasing

equation.explanation: Due to circuit symmetry, the negative switching threshold is equal in magnitude and opposite in sign to the positive switching threshold.

sky130_expected.calculation: For symmetric sizing beta_A = beta_B, VSPL = -0 V = 0 V. For beta_B/beta_A = 1.2, VSPL = -11.1 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Antisymmetric relation to VSPH around vm.

output_high_voltage.description: High-state output voltage of the decision circuit (vop or vom)

equation.explanation: When all tail current is steered to one branch (iop ≈ Iss), the diode-connected transistor M5 (or M8) sets the high output level according to the square-law saturation equation.
equation.assumptions: M5 in saturation, iop = Iss = 40 uA, VTHN = 0.42 V, beta_A = un*Cox*(W/L) = 270 uA/V^2 * (10/1) = 2.7 mA/V^2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by NMOS threshold voltage plus overdrive under Iss current conduction.

output_low_voltage.description: Low-state output voltage of the decision circuit (vop or vom)

equation.explanation: When M7/M6 is fully turned on and pulls the opposite node to ground with zero or minimal current flowing through that branch, the output pulls down close to ground.
equation.assumptions: M7 strongly conducts with zero/leakage drain current from M4.

sky130_expected.calculation: Near 0 V, determined by the on-resistance of NMOS pull-down and residual leakage current: Vol ≈ 0.05 V - 0.15 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite off-state current from the current mirror PMOS prevents reaching exactly 0 V.

tail_current.description: Tail bias current Iss supplied to the input differential pair

equation.explanation: Bias tail current sourced by NMOS current source biased by Vbiasn.
equation.assumptions: Vbiasn generated by SUB_1 bias circuit to set Iss nominal target of 40 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: Design target from Fig. 27.5 and Ex. 27.1 is Iss = 40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bias circuit tolerance across process and VDD=1.8V.

input_transconductance.description: Transconductance gm of the input differential pair transistors M1, M2

equation.explanation: Transconductance of input pair transistor at balance condition (vp = vm).
equation.assumptions: M1, M2 in saturation; I_D1 = I_D2 = Iss / 2 = 20 uA; un*Cox = 270 uA/V^2; (W/L) = 10/1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical square-law transconductance for 20 uA branch current in SKY130.

total_static_power.description: Total quiescent power consumption of the pre-amp and decision circuit including bias network

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8 V supply rail under balanced DC bias conditions.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V; Iss = 40 uA, mirror current Iss = 40 uA, bias circuit consumes ~40-80 uA; Itotal ≈ 120 - 160 uA.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power dissipation scales with VDD = 1.8 V and sum of currents in pre-amp, mirror branches, and bias block.

step3_testbench.description: SPICE testbench to simulate the pre-amp and decision circuit of Fig. 27.5 on SKY130 PDK. Performs DC operating point to determine Iss, gm, and power, followed by a forward and reverse DC sweep of vp around vm to characterize switching points (VSPH, VSPL), hysteresis, and output swing levels (VOH, VOL).
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pre-amp and Decision Circuit (Fig. 27.5, Baker Ch 27)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions for nominal sizing
.param W_xmsu3=20u L_xmsu3=2u
.param W_xm31=30u  L_xm31=2u
.param W_xm41=30u  L_xm41=2u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=2u
.param W_xm2=10u   L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm3=30u   L_xm3=2u
.param W_xm4=30u   L_xm4=2u
.param W_xm5=10u   L_xm5=2u
.param W_xm6=12u   L_xm6=2u
.param W_xm7=12u   L_xm7=2u
.param W_xm8=10u   L_xm8=2u

.param W_xmsu1=10u L_xmsu1=2u
.param W_xmsu2=10u L_xmsu2=2u
.param W_xm3_bias=30u L_xm3_bias=2u
.param W_xm4_bias=30u L_xm4_bias=2u
.param W_xm1_bias=10u L_xm1_bias=2u
.param W_xm2_bias=10u L_xm2_bias=2u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Device Under Test (DUT)
xmsu3 N003 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm31  N002 N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm31} l={L_xm31}
xm41  N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm41} l={L_xm41}
xm2   N001 vm N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm1   N002 vp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}

X_U1  Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD 0 SUB_1

Vp vp 0 0.9
Vm vm 0 0.9

xm3   vop N002 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4   vom N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm5   vop vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6   vop vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7   vom vop 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8   vom vom 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

* Bias Circuit Subcircuit
.subckt SUB_1 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD GND
  xmsu2 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
  xmsu1 N001 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
  xmsu3 VDD N001 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
  xm3   Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3_bias} l={L_xm3_bias}
  xm4   Vbiasp Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4_bias} l={L_xm4_bias}
  xm1   Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1_bias} l={L_xm1_bias}
  xm2   Vbiasp Vbiasn N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2_bias} l={L_xm2_bias}
  R1    N002 GND 6.5k
.ends SUB_1

* Control Script
.control
  op
  let Iss = -i(VDD)
  let pwr = -i(VDD) * 1.8
  print Iss pwr

  * Forward DC sweep: vp swept from 0.8V to 1.0V (increasing)
  dc Vp 0.8 1.0 0.001
  let diff_out = v(vop) - v(vom)
  meas dc voh max v(vop)
  meas dc vol min v(vom)
  meas dc vp_switch_high when diff_out=0 rise=1
  let vsph = vp_switch_high - 0.9
  print vsph voh vol

  * Backward DC sweep: vp swept from 1.0V down to 0.8V (decreasing)
  dc Vp 1.0 0.8 -0.001
  let diff_out_rev = v(vop) - v(vom)
  meas dc vp_switch_low when diff_out_rev=0 fall=1
  let vspl = vp_switch_low - 0.9
  let v_hyst = vsph - vspl
  print vspl v_hyst

  quit
.endc
.end
